description: This file defines the Node class used for representing nodes in a tree view structure within SuiteCRM. It includes properties for node attributes, methods for setting properties, adding child nodes, and obtaining the node's definition as a nested array.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: A class representing a node in a tree structure, with properties for label, target, id, and children nodes, along with methods to set properties, add child nodes, and generate a nested array definition.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing node label, id, expanded state, and generating a unique ID.

methods.name: set_property
methods.description: Sets a property or parameter for the node, which can be accessed in JavaScript or used in node behavior.

methods.name: add_node
methods.description: Adds a child node to the current node.

methods.name: get_definition
methods.description: Returns a nested array representing the node's data, custom attributes, and child nodes, suitable for rendering in a tree view.
